verdict.rationale: Anrok's API has a documented endpoint to fetch filings, uses bearer API keys, and the Headless Tax marketing says you can 'hand it to your agents'. Only one piece of the tax posture (filings) is evidenced as API-readable, and the agent path is a vague marketing line. missing for 10: API endpoints for nexus status, registrations and accrued liability; a documented MCP server or agent surface; scoped or least-privilege credentials (only a single bearer API key is shown); documented agent actions on posture; independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can read my tax posture — nexus status, registrations, accrued liability, upcoming filings — and act on it through the API or an MCP surface with scoped credentials

citations.quote: This endpoint can be used to fetch filings from Anrok.
Run tax through Anrok's APIs, or hand it to your agents.
